name: resume
description: Resume and domain entry. Reads canonical disk state to locate a devflow-managed project's current position, recover an interrupted transition, and either report it or route to the stage that owns the next step. On request, opens one capability document by number or name and explains that domain with bounded reads. Another named devflow stage enters directly. Use when explicitly invoked, when another devflow skill routes here, or for work in an existing devflow-managed project.
problem: Preserve the behavior of the prose source in skills/resume without silently changing its obligations.
state_dependent_behaviors: Source contains candidate conditional, ordered, or evidence-bound behavior requiring review.
Canonical setup.unmanaged reports no current .devflow root or current-index membership evidence and ends without ASK, route, or write; domain orientation remains first.
judgment_points: Every source atom remains review-required until explicitly disposed.
